finding: YES — the distill's lost MTP speed is recoverable, and not from its own family: a 0.7 GB Q4_K_M DFlash drafter retrained for the PARENT Qwen3.5-9B drafts for the distill at 0.794 acceptance / mean 7.31 accepted on code (vs 0.0005 for the parent-MTP-head graft) — the distill drift that kills single-layer nextn heads does NOT kill a 6-layer block-diffusion sidecar. caveats: (1) practical ctx is 8192 (16K + drafter is ~200 MB over VRAM; 32K hopeless) — the AG-Bench tasks that fit 8K are fine, the 32K long-context class needs the fork/ubatch trade-offs measured separately or a Q2_K drafter requant (~0.45 GB) which is the NEXT measurement; (2) upstream kernels drift bytes vs serial (0/6) — fork-exactness path for draft-dflash untested; (3) prefill unchanged (spec helps decode only).
verdict: MiMo-9B + DFlash-Q4_K_M sidecar is the new fastest 9B-class THINKING serve on the card: efficiency profile (42.5 pass/h) should scale further if AG-Bench tasks stay within 8K ctx. Follow-ups queued in NEXT-IDEAS.
